one_line: Anthropic targets a $1.4 trillion valuation in an upcoming IPO, while Google rolls out Gemini 4 Carbon and new TPU chips.

themes.title: Anthropic targets $1.4 trillion IPO valuation
themes.text: Anthropic filed an IPO prospectus offering 825 million Class A shares at $70 to $78, targeting a valuation of up to $1.404 trillion. The offering includes major investments from tech giants such as Nvidia and TSMC, alongside new collaboration tools and enterprise capability groups.

stories.headline: Anthropic sets IPO price at $70–$78 per share, targeting $1.4 trillion valuation
TSMC to invest up to $1B in Anthropic and OpenAI at IPO price
Anthropic co-founders to sell $1.75 billion in shares ahead of $1.4 trillion IPO
Anthropic sets IPO price range aiming for up to $1.4 trillion valuation
Nvidia plans $10B investment in Anthropic alongside its IPO

themes.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon and new TPUs
themes.text: Google is rolling out Gemini 4 Carbon to the public with an introductory pricing model and a preview of an agent swarm feature. Additionally, Google unveiled two new eighth-generation tensor processing units, TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max.

stories.headline: Google rolls out Gemini 4 Carbon to the public with agent swarm feature
Google unveils TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max for confidential and large-scale AI workloads

themes.title: Chip export controls face heightened scrutiny
themes.text: A spy scandal has exposed networks in Singapore helping Chinese tech companies access U.S. AI chips and bypass export controls. Sources indicate this has raised the likelihood of Congress enacting chip export limits via the National Defense Authorization Act.

stories.headline: Nvidia spy scandal exposes Singapore chip networks evading US export controls
Jensen Huang affair raises chances of US chip export limits in NDAA
